messages:
lena: Quick design review thread for the rollout timeline + canary controls. Main items: weight slider clarity, keyboard access for timeline scrubber, and the rollback confirmation wording is a bit scary. Sketch: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh/rollout-timeline (private). Thoughts? rob: On the slider: users keep asking whether the number is allocation or percent-of-traffic. Suggest we show a persistent % chip next to the thumb ("35%") and a small inline hint below: 'drag or use arrow keys'. Tooltip on drag shows exact counts (e.g. "35% ~ 3,500 req/min"). priya: Accessibility: the slider must be a real `role=slider` with `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax`/`aria-valuenow` and an accessible label. Keyboard: left/right +/-1, shift+arrow +/-10, pageup/pagedown +/-25, home/end jump to 0/100. Also ensure the focus ring is high-contrast and not suppressed by custom styles. a11y-bot: A11y checklist: add `aria-live="polite"` on a status region that announces allocation changes ("Canary set to 35% for variant B"). For the timeline scrubber, when snapshots change, update `aria-atomic` so screen readers read the snapshot summary. Check color contrast on the heatmap overlays (need at least 3:1 for non-text UI components). rob: Good call. Also we should support keyboard scrubbing on the timeline: left/right to go +/-1 snapshot, shift+left/right to jump 5, home/end to start/end. Add a tooltip on hover that shows exact snapshot timestamp and commit id. ux-researcher: From research sessions: users want a small always-visible microcopy near the slider: 'Hold shift to step by 10%'. Also on accidental rollbacks participants asked for a slower safety net: change the modal from 'Confirm rollback' to 'Confirm rollback to v1.11.4 (this will route traffic immediately)'. Add a 3-second delay on the primary CTA and show the affected routes list. lena: Copy tweak proposal: primary CTA should read 'Rollback to v1.11.4 and Route Traffic' and the secondary 'Cancel'. Add a one-line explanation under the title: 'This will redirect live traffic instantly. Use canary first if unsure.' priya: Visual affordance for canary weight on the timeline: use a patterned overlay (diagonal hatch) in addition to color to help colorblind users and grayscale prints. Ensure the hatch density scales with weight for quick visual estimation. a11y-bot: Motion note: timeline scrubber auto-play and snapshot flips should honor `prefers-reduced-motion`. If snapshots auto-advance, ensure there's an `aria-live` announcement and provide a toggle to disable auto-advance per-user. rob: Tiny code example for slider aria attributes: ```html
...
``` priya: Also ensure tooltips are accessible: `role="tooltip"` and `aria-describedby` from the focused element. Tooltips must appear on focus, not just hover. deploy-bot: deploy-bot: event recorded: canary-allocation-adjusted variant=B value=35 user=rob ts=1769990065 lena: Ok, action items: Rob to update slider microcopy + keyboard doc, Priya to add ARIA/contrast checklist, UX-researcher to update prototype text and test with 3 participants, and I'll schedule quick hands-on session Wed 10am. Thanks all!
